# Coreward — llms.txt

> Governance spine for agent-written code: preflight → bound work → evidence → promote.

## Must-read (docs triad)

- [docs/start-here.md](./docs/start-here.md) — activate (`coreward:init` / `activate --governed`)
- [docs/operate.md](./docs/operate.md) — Go / Approve / Merge
- [docs/ward-security.md](./docs/ward-security.md) — Ward + house rules vs Mandate

Also: [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) — call MCP `preflight` once · [LICENSE.md](./LICENSE.md)

## Commands

- `npm run coreward:init`
- `npm run coreward:authorize -- --files a.ts,b.ts`
- `npm run gate:mcp` — MCP server `coreward-release-gates`
- `npm run ward:doctor`

## Non-claims

Not a kernel IDE sandbox. Hosted HPURL verify unbuilt. No pricing tiers in this tree.
